title: Interpersonal Theory of Suicide as a Lens to Examine Suicidal Ideation in Online Spaces
reasoning: The paper focuses on clinical psychology and the use of LLMs (GPT-4o) to provide supportive responses to suicidal ideation. While it includes a discussion on ethical implications and algorithmic bias, and uses clinical frameworks (like SAFE-T) for evaluation, it is not a benchmark or study of religion, secular ethics, or moral reasoning.
